# Plan 6: Resource Pack Content Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace every placeholder look and sound in MinigameCore and Paintball with our own resource
pack (models, textures, sounds, HUD glyphs, menu backgrounds), host it from server 5, and prove it
with real in-game screenshots from a 26.3 client.

**Architecture:** All art is generated by committed Python scripts (`tools/pack_src/`), so the pack
is reproducible; the generated files are committed under `resourcepack/` so CI builds the zip
without extra tooling. The plugins point at pack assets through `item_model`, `custom_model_data`
(team tint and splat variant/fade), `dbsdw:` sound events and `dbsdw:` fonts in `messages.yml`.
Verification uses a real 26.3 client in Docker on node1 (Xvfb + Mesa software rendering), driven
with `xdotool`, joining the deployed test servers (4 → 5) the way a player does.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3.13 + Pillow (textures, run in `python:3.13-slim`), pure-Python synthesis +
`ffmpeg` (sounds to Ogg Vorbis), Paper 26.3 API (`DataComponentTypes.ITEM_MODEL`,
`CUSTOM_MODEL_DATA`, Adventure `Sound`), Java 25, resource pack format 97.1.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-18-minigames-paintball-design.md` (§7.2–§7.7, §9).

## Global Constraints

- Pack format `[97, 1]`; namespace `dbsdw`; no vanilla item or asset is retextured (§9.1).
- Style: cartoony, bright, saturated team colours, thick dark outlines. Red `#FF3B30`, blue
  `#2F7BFF`, neutral gun body yellow `#FFC21A`, outline `#1B1B2F`.
- All art original (generated by our scripts); `resourcepack/CREDITS.md` says so.
- Player text stays Dutch; MiniMessage in `messages.yml`.
- Test servers only (panel servers 4 and 5, node1). Live survival (server 2) is not touched.
- Client and helper containers on node1 have hard memory caps (client 3 GB, ViaProxy 768 MB, bot
  256 MB); never on the WDP host. Never `pkill -f` over SSH on node1.
- Gradle via the Docker command in `HANDOFF.md`; Python generators via `docker run --rm -u 1000:1000
  -v "$PWD":/work -w /work python:3.13-slim sh -c 'pip install -q pillow==11.* && python …'`.
- Branch `plan-6-resource-pack` from `main`; one PR at the end.

## Asset table (the contract between pack and plugins)

**Item models** (`resourcepack/assets/dbsdw/items/<id>.json`; all tints read `custom_model_data`
`colors[0]`):

| id | Shape | Tint | Used by |
|----|-------|------|---------|
| `gun` | 3D elements model, own first/third-person/gui transforms | stripe + hopper = team colour (default yellow) | `Gun.gun`, games/modes menu icon |
| `paintball` | flat sprite | whole ball | `Gun.ball` (snowball item) |
| `splat` | flat plane, `range_dispatch` on `floats[0]` = shape 0/1/2, nested `floats[1]` = fade stage 0..3 | team colour | `Splats` (ItemDisplay) |
| `flag` | 3D pole + cloth, `fixed` (on base) and `head` (carried) transforms | cloth | `FlagView`, carrier helmet |
| `powerup_rapid_fire`, `powerup_triple_shot`, `powerup_speed`, `powerup_shield`, `powerup_repair` | extruded sprites (`item/generated`) | none | `PowerupView` |
| `lobby_games`, `lobby_stats`, `lobby_survival` | extruded sprites | none | `LobbyService` hotbar |

Display-only items use base material `PAPER`; the gun keeps `CARROT_ON_A_STICK` (cooldown
animation).

**Sound events** (`resourcepack/assets/dbsdw/sounds.json`, category players; replaces the vanilla
sound now at each call site):

`paintball.shot` (PaintballMatch:333) · `paintball.splat` (new, block hit, quiet) ·
`paintball.hit` (:274) · `paintball.hitmarker` (:279) · `paintball.eliminate` (:288) ·
`paintball.out` (:405) · `paintball.respawn` (:429) · `paintball.shield_block` (:264) ·
`paintball.shield_break` (:266) · `paintball.flag.taken` / `.dropped` / `.returned` / `.captured`
(:498-502) · `paintball.powerup` (:576) · core: `match.countdown` (MatchManager.countdown, last
5 s), `match.start` (RunningMatch:83), `match.win` / `match.lose` / `match.draw` (results screen,
per player).

**Glyphs** (bitmap providers; text colour multiplies white glyphs):

| font | char | glyph |
|------|------|-------|
| `dbsdw:hud` | U+E000 | paint drop (white; coloured team / dark grey for hits left) |
| `dbsdw:hud` | U+E001 | shield · U+E002 rapid fire · U+E003 triple shot · U+E004 speed · U+E005 repair (full colour) |
| `dbsdw:hud` | U+E006 | hit-marker cross · U+E007 spawn-protection bubble · U+E008 team splat (white, tinted) |
| `dbsdw:overlay` | U+E010 | full-screen paint splash (white, tinted by shooter team), shown as the hit title |
| `dbsdw:menu` | U+E100 / U+E101 | games-menu / modes-menu background; `space` provider U+F800 = −8, U+F801 = −169 advances |

## Review Focus

1. A Java or messages key with no matching pack asset → purple-black item, silent sound or tofu box.
   Expect the build to fail instead: `tools/test_pack_keys.py` (Task 4).
2. A splat that is removed (match end, cap) while its fade stage changes → no exception, no ghost
   display. `SplatFade` boundary tests + `isValid()` guard (Task 5).
3. The deployed `messages.yml` on server 5 keeps old values (plugins only add new keys) → no
   glyphs. Deployment resets it (Task 6) and the notes say live will need the same.
4. Pack URL unreachable from outside (allocation/ufw missing) → every join fails. Task 6 checks the
   URL from the WDP host (outside node1) before the client run.
5. Splat translucency: fade stages with partial alpha may render opaque or z-fight on the wall.
   Screenshot scene S6/S7 must show it; fallback is shrinking instead of alpha (Task 7).

### Task 3: Sounds

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/pack_src/sounds.py`; generated `resourcepack/assets/dbsdw/sounds/**/*.ogg`,
  `resourcepack/assets/dbsdw/sounds.json`

- [ ] **Step 1:** `sounds.py`: pure-Python synthesis (math + `wave`, fixed seeds) to 44.1 kHz mono
  WAV, then `ffmpeg -c:a libvorbis -q:a 4` to `.ogg`; 2 variants for `shot`, `splat`, `hit`.
  Character: shot = short pneumatic pop; splat/hit = wet noise burst; hitmarker = high click;
  eliminate = rising two-note; out = descending splash; flag = bright chimes; countdown = tick;
  win = major arpeggio; lose = minor fall; draw = two equal notes. Each ≤ 1.5 s, peak −1 dBFS.
- [ ] **Step 2:** `sounds.json` with every event in the asset table; `build_pack.py` passes; commit.

### Task 7: Screenshot verification

Client `PackShooter` (op on server 5 via console) plus one bot (`hop.js` through a ViaProxy
container pointed at `62.83.125.228:27111`, whitelisted + registered on server 4). Shots go to
`/tmp/plan6-shots/` on the WDP host (not committed). Every shot is viewed; anything wrong goes
back to Tasks 1–5, then that shot is retaken.

| Shot | Scene | Pass when |
|------|-------|-----------|
| S1 | Lobby, hotbar | no pack prompt; 3 lobby items show our sprites; leaderboards readable |
| S2/S3 | games menu, modes menu open | our background fits the slots; gun icon; title text aligned |
| S4 | In match, first person, gun held | 3D gun in team colour; sidebar, bossbar, drop glyphs in action bar |
| S5 | F5 third person, and looking at the bot | gun held correctly in third person |
| S6 | Firing at a wall (hold right click 2 s) | paintballs visible mid-air in team colour; splats on the wall, 3 shapes, no z-fighting |
| S7 | Same wall 16 s later | splats visibly faded (or shrunk, see Review Focus 5) |
| S8 | Bot shoots the client | splash overlay on screen in the bot's colour, drop glyph turns grey |
| S9 | Out | "Uit!" title, respawn countdown |
| S10 | Showcase row (console `summon item_display` of every item id, both tints, all splat stages) | nothing purple-black; every model readable |
| S11 | CTF: flag on base; bot carrying it (flag on head) | flag model on base and on head, cloth in team colour |
| S12 | Power-up picked (console `tp` onto a point) | icon + seconds in action bar; shield icon |
